deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies".
In the policies page, click on "Return Policy".
Scroll down to the "Return reasons" section and click on the "Add return reason" button.
Enter a name for the return reason and select the type (e.g. 'Defective', 'Not as described').
Click "Save" to save the new return reason.
Next, navigate to "Settings" > "Apps" and search for the returns app you want to integrate with.
Install and configure the app according to its instructions.
In the app's settings, look for a section related to embedding a returns reason capture form.
Copy the provided code snippet and paste it into your Shopify theme's liquid file (e.g. `layout.liquid` or `product.liquid`).
Make sure to place the code in the correct location to display the form at the right time in the returns flow.
Save the changes to your theme and test the returns process on your store to ensure the form is working as expected.
